title: Descriptive and recount — Level 10 — Final challenge

items.prompt: Kata mana yang kurang tepat dalam recount ini? "Last week, we go to the zoo."
Kata mana yang kurang tepat dalam descriptive ini? "My dog have a long tail."
Kalimat mana yang kurang tepat untuk menutup recount?

visual.text: I hope I can go there again.

choices.say: I hope I can go there again.

items.reteach: Perlu adjective: patient (sabar). Patience adalah noun.

items.prompt: Kata penghubung mana yang kurang tepat? "First, we packed. Finally, we drove to the airport. Then we flew to Bali."
items.reteach: Finally untuk kejadian terakhir, bukan di tengah.

items.prompt: Uncle Hasan text: Why is his skin dark?

stimulus.text: My uncle Hasan is a fisherman in Probolinggo. He is tall and strong, with dark skin from the sun. He is cheerful and always whistles while he fixes his net.

items.prompt: Uncle Hasan text: Which word describes his personality?

stimulus.text: My uncle Hasan is a fisherman in Probolinggo. He is tall and strong, with dark skin from the sun. He is cheerful and always whistles while he fixes his net.

items.reteach: Cheerful (ceria) adalah sifat; tall, strong, dark adalah penampilan.

items.prompt: Uncle Hasan text: What does he do while he fixes his net?

stimulus.text: My uncle Hasan is a fisherman in Probolinggo. He is tall and strong, with dark skin from the sun. He is cheerful and always whistles while he fixes his net.

items.reteach: Always whistles while he fixes his net.

items.prompt: Bali trip text: How long was the trip?

stimulus.text: During the holiday, I went to Bali by bus with my parents. The trip took twelve hours. I was tired, but when I saw Kuta Beach, I forgot about it.

items.reteach: I forgot about it = lupa rasa lelahnya.

items.prompt: Urutkan kalimat recount: (1) Then we swam. (2) Last Sunday we went to the beach. (3) Finally, we went home.
Urutkan: (1) After that, we had lunch. (2) First, we visited the museum. (3) Yesterday my class had a field trip. (4) We were happy.
Kalimat mana yang paling tepat menjadi kalimat pertama descriptive text tentang zebra? (1) It has black and white stripes. (2) The zebra is a wild animal from Africa. (3) It eats grass.
items.reteach: Identification (memperkenalkan) ada di awal: The zebra is …

items.prompt: Riddle: I am a text. I start with an orientation and end with a reorientation. My events happened in the past. What am I?
Riddle: I am a text. I start with an identification and then describe parts, colours and habits. What am I?
Odd one out (bukan kata penghubung waktu): first, then, finally, beautiful
Odd one out (bukan kata sifat penampilan): tall, curly, slim, honest
Logic: A recount says, "We left at 7 a.m. We arrived three hours later." What time did they arrive?
Logic: "I have a pet. It has eight legs and makes webs." What is my pet?
items.reteach: Delapan kaki dan membuat jaring = spider.

items.prompt: Logic: In a recount, which connective usually comes LAST?
Analogy: descriptive is to "is / has" as recount is to …
Riddle: I am a fruit. I am big and spiky, and I smell very strong, but many people love my taste. What am I?
Riddle: I am an animal. In Madura, people race me in a festival called Karapan. What am I?

Puzzle: Which order of adjectives is correct? "a ___ ball"
